title: Perry Compiles TypeScript directly to executables using SWC and LLVM
summary: Perry is a compiler that transforms TypeScript code directly into native executables by leveraging SWC for fast TypeScript parsing and LLVM for optimized machine code generation, eliminating the need for a JavaScript runtime environment.
problem_solved: Enables TypeScript developers to compile their code into standalone native executables without requiring Node.js or any JavaScript engine at runtime.
why_valuable: Provides significant performance benefits and smaller distribution sizes by compiling TypeScript directly to machine code, making it ideal for CLI tools, serverless functions, and performance-critical applications.
